acceptance: Use only a forward migration; latest schema marker and checksum verification must include it.
Under a restricted PostgreSQL role, known-good application writes for all three row families still work with matching unit/workspace context.
Known-bad inserts for each row family are rejected with PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 42501 for mismatched workspace context and for mismatched organization context.
Command receipt claim, dispatch, settlement/reconciliation, append-only audit, canonical snapshot replay, and role snapshot projection remain compatible.
The disposable PostgreSQL wrapper proves migration, normal PostgreSQL behavior, role/RLS checks, container inventory unchanged, and cleanup; no shared database is allowed.
Run focused relevant checks plus npm test; do not promote MEL23-023 unless the coverage includes every table in its defined wave.
known_limits: This slice does not prove cross-scope isolation for all 24 SNAPSHOT_PRIMARY domain tables.
External authority, production-like cutover, backup restore after cutover, and human release approval remain outside this local slice.
